# clone URL

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:cloneUrl`](gmeow-cloneUrl.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/cloneUrl>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

A URL from which the repository can be cloned. Non-functional: multiple protocols (https, ssh, git) may be available.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Repository`](../classes/gmeow-Repository.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:cloneUrl`](gmeow-cloneUrl.md) from [`gmeow:Repository`](../classes/gmeow-Repository.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
